dashboard: Your command center: KPI cards for the lead pipeline, the stage funnel, top-scored leads and the recent activity feed.
executive-overview: How outreach is converting across the company, with cards, bars and rows you can click to dig into the detail.
pipeline: The campaign board: one column per stage, one card per lead with its score and latest activity, plus filters by state, program, minimum score and sort order.
map: Leads plotted on a map so you can see where properties are and open one from its pin.
agent-field-view: A phone-friendly view for working leads in the field: touch a pin to see the lead, with call-quality feedback and assignment override.
time-clock: Clock in and out and track your breaks.
system-health: Live status checks of every AVYRO service, with a 90-day history you can click into by day.
trulia-source-health: Checks that the Trulia lead source is still delivering clean data, with a button to run a sync for that source.
sync-ops: Live source pulls, per-portfolio health, validation and alerts for the data sync.
sync-regression-monitor: Flags synced leads that fail quality checks, so a source that starts returning bad data is noticed within days.
sync-diagnostics: Row-by-row detail of sync runs: click any row to expand what happened and why.
enrichment-rules-engine: The saved confidence rules for enrichment, and any real violations caught during validation.
enrichment-validation-analytics: How enrichment results hold up under validation: pass and fail rates over time.
enrichment-review-queue: Enrichment results that need a person to approve or reject them before they are trusted.
source-intelligence: Share, quality, verification and conversion per lead source, computed from real counts of the leads.
enrichment-costs: What enrichment and skip-trace lookups cost, so you can keep spending in check.
integration-health: Whether each connected service (sync sources, messaging, email) is up and responding.
rescore-events: An audit log of every lead score change: who triggered it, when, old versus new score and the reason.
lead-data-quality: Where lead records are missing or inconsistent, so they can be fixed before outreach.
data-quality-monitor: Ongoing data-quality checks across the lead database and how they trend.
property-verification-debug: Trace any property through the verification pipeline to see why it did or did not pass.
teleprompter: The call workspace: a live script and lead details for making calls.
interview-teleprompter: The live teleprompter in interview mode, used when interviewing candidates.
admin-lead-queue: The live queue of leads waiting for an agent.
interview-calendar: Scheduled candidate interviews on a calendar.
interview-recordings: Recordings of past interviews to review.
candidate-profiles: Hiring candidates and their profiles in one place.
candidate-kanban: Hiring candidates on a board, moved between stages.
candidate-pipeline: The hiring funnel: how many candidates sit at each stage of recruiting.
consistency-report: Compares what a candidate said in their resume with what they said in the interview.
candidate-tracker: A tracker for every candidate and where they stand.
offer-letters: Create and track offer letters for candidates.
candidate-sequences: Automated messages sent to candidates as they move through hiring.
hiring-analytics: Recruiting metrics: how candidates move through hiring and where they drop off.
headset-setup: Set up and test your headset and microphone for calls.
call-analytics: Call volume, outcomes and talk time across the team.
cron-monitor: Whether the scheduled background jobs (syncs, enrichment, sends) are running on time and what they did.
lead-auto-assign: AI lead auto-assignment: how new leads are given to agents.
score-retraining: Record closed-deal outcomes so the prospect scoring model can be retrained, and see past retraining runs.
advanced-reports: Deeper reports you can slice by market, source, agent and period.
campaign-analytics: Results per campaign: sends, replies and conversions.
template-perf: Which message templates get replies and which do not.
outreach-performance: How outreach performs by channel, agent and message.
audit-trail: A record of who changed what in the system.
admin-audit-log: The administrator-level log of sensitive actions.
compliance-audit: Checks outreach against compliance rules such as opt-outs and quiet hours.
compliance-change-log: A history of changes to compliance settings and rules.
city-regulations: Short-term-rental regulations by city, so you know the rules before you pitch an owner.
pre-launch-checklist: The pre-launch compliance checklist for a property: click an item to cycle its status and open its reference.
onboarding-doc-review: Review and approve the documents homeowners upload during short-term-rental onboarding.
checklist-auto-advance: Settings that automatically advance stale onboarding checklist steps and remind homeowners about pending items.
exports: Exports that run on a schedule and are delivered to you.
csv-export: Download leads as a CSV file with the columns you choose.
score-breakdown: Why a lead has its score: how much each factor contributed.
roi-calculator: Work out revenue against cost and the return on outreach and enrichment.
lead-lifecycle: The funnel from new lead to live property, with the drop-off at each step.
agent-management: Add, edit and set up agents, including territories and lead permissions.
user-management: Manage user accounts, roles and whether each person is active.
agents: The earlier agents screen, where you change an agent's role, territories and default lead permissions.
agent-leaderboard: Agents ranked by activity and results.
agent-performance: Per-agent performance: calls, conversions and trends.
agent-conversion-analytics: How each agent's leads convert, stage to stage.
conversion-analytics: Close rates across the team, by stage and source.
agent-routing: Agent routing: a lead batch report and weekly actual versus predicted conversion.
agent-productivity: How much each agent gets done: calls, texts and follow-ups.
team-agents: Per-agent call volume, conversion rates, talk time and coaching flags, with a 7-day view.
team-lead-board: Every lead on the team's board, with the option to reassign a lead.
agent-workload-board: How many leads each agent is carrying, so work can be balanced.
manager-team-metrics: Manager view of the team: stage breakdown by agent and revenue against cost with ROI.
commission-rules: Set how agent commissions are calculated.
commissions: Your own commissions and what they are based on.
ai-features: The AI features of the app (Claude), shown with whether the API key is configured to switch them on.
workflows: Build email and SMS sequences that automate outreach.
operations: Property operations: cleanings, maintenance and inventory across all properties.
integration-hub: Connect services, manage API keys and watch usage quotas.
admin-management: Admin tools for SMS templates (variables fill in at send time) and pre-built replies to common homeowner objections.
admin-config: API keys, verification status, rate limits, sync intervals and environment settings.
webhook-inspector: See the webhooks AVYRO has received and what they contained, to debug an integration.
base44-submissions: Submissions received from the Base44 forms.
ops-monitoring: A real-time operations dashboard: API health, delivery rates, enrichment syncs, webhook health and an incident timeline.
performance-dashboard: Real-time latency, render, API and session health.
score-simulator: Try changes to the scoring and see how leads would score before you apply them.
scoring-rules: The rules behind the prospect score.
score-weight-editor: Adjust how much each factor counts toward the prospect score.
bulk-actions: Apply one action, such as an assignment or stage change, to many leads at once.
admin-roles: Roles and permissions: who can see and do what.
admin-events: A dashboard of system events as they happen.
nurture-cadence: The nurture cadence engine: choose a sequence and manage the long, gentle follow-up for leads who have not replied.
notifications: Choose which notifications you receive and how.
help-center: Answers, articles and guides for every part of the app.
agent-workspace: Your own dashboard: today's work, your leads and what needs doing next.
agent-my-leads: The leads assigned to you, to search, filter and work.
agent-followups: Your leads that have a follow-up due.
agent-self-performance: Your own results: calls, conversions and goals.
refresh: Opens Data Sync, where you refresh the lead data.
